fields.statement: Verified at ed1957908: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipGateRunLog|TestShipRebase' -v passes (13 tests). TestShipGateRunLog with RHIZA_RUN set runs a failing gate printing '--- FAIL: TestX', 20000 filler lines (>64 KB) and make's Error 1 line twice: both logs land as distinct files in run.Dir/<run>/ (gate-<n>.log, O_EXCL so never overwritten), each holds the whole output incl. 'Error 1', the last 20 human lines hold '--- FAIL: TestX' and 'Full log: <path>' within stepTailBytes (the command step's journal detail keeps the last 20 lines / 2048 bytes, so a failing gate step's detail names the log), and a passing gate also writes its log there; TestShipRebaseRunsLocalGate shows the no-run log at <common>/rhiza/gate/cs/ship-it.log. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow ok; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden ok (golden carries the new log desc). grep -c 'run `rhiza ship gate` to see' on internal/workflow/builtin/ship-change.toml, .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml, .rhiza/workflows/docs.toml prints 0 for all three, and each file's two gate-fix prompts tell the fixer to read the full gate log (`Full log:`) instead of rerunning rhiza ship gate. make self-check passes (exit 0) in a clean detached worktree of the commit with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN/LEAF/ACTOR unset; in the run worktree it failed only on the verifier session's own unrendered actor record. Read the diff of internal/api/ship_gate.go: run id resolved via the run store, path-traversal ids refused.
